---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Antigravity"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-plot

storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Count of Storm Types per Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: filtered-storms
#| cache: true
storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: pressure-wind-scatter

storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pressure, y = wind, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Air Pressure and Wind Speed",
    subtitle = "Lower central pressure produces higher wind speeds, especially in hurricanes",
    x = "Atmospheric Pressure (mbar)",
    y = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    color = "Storm Status"
  )
```
